mechanism: probe() closes the file only on the success path. Both early returns -- a foreign file and a truncated header, the two cases the docstring says are expected -- leave the descriptor open. The compactor probes thousands of files per run, so descriptors accumulate until the process hits its open-file limit and unrelated opens start failing.
